description: This file contains JavaScript code that initializes and manages terminal-like animations, dynamic announcements, and sponsor image handling on a webpage. It defines functions for setting up terminal displays, shuffling elements, showing random announcements, and handling sponsor images, along with event listeners for scrolling and document subscription.

classes.name: Termynal
classes.description: A class used to create terminal-like animations and interactions on the webpage.

methods.name: setupTermynal
methods.description: Initializes terminal animations on elements with class 'use-termynal'.

methods.name: createTermynals
methods.description: Creates and configures Termynal instances based on code blocks.

methods.name: loadVisibleTermynals
methods.description: Loads and initializes Termynal instances that are visible in the viewport.

methods.name: showRandomAnnouncement
methods.description: Displays random announcements from a group at specified intervals.

methods.name: handleSponsorImages
methods.description: Handles loading of sponsor images and displays sponsor section upon load.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that sets up terminal animations, announcements, and sponsor images.
